name: Commercial Food Service
old_description: We offer a wide selection of professional restaurant supplies, perfect for home chefs and restauranteurs. From cookware and bakeware to utensils and gadgets, we have everything you need to equip your kitchen for success.
about:
Commercial Food Service operates from Odessa, Texas, where it was founded in 2006 as a family-owned restaurant supply and equipment dealer. The company serves the greater Midland–Odessa area and the broader Permian Basin region from a cash-and-carry showroom that is open to the public.

The business stocks and sells commercial kitchen equipment including dishwashers, ice machines, kitchen hoods, walk-in coolers and freezers, and a wide range of restaurant smallwares such as flatware, dishware, utensils, and serving pieces. Beyond product sales, it provides full-service installation, replacement, and 24/7 repair for the equipment it sells, as well as knife sharpening. A dedicated design team handles commercial kitchen layout, configuration, and permit-approval assistance for new builds and renovations.

Customers include independent restaurants, hotels, churches, institutional kitchens, and home chefs throughout the Permian Basin. The company cites long-standing relationships with local foodservice operators and positions itself as a one-stop shop for both supplies and project support.

Leadership emphasizes responsive service, competitive pricing, and the convenience of bundled design, procurement, and installation under one roof. The 24-hour technician availability and permit-handling support are highlighted as key reasons customers choose the firm.
